description: The same brush over a map, dragged along latitude only, and it is not the two-channel case with a channel removed. The rectangle spans the plot across, so the brush is a band over the map rather than a line; and the two stated latitudes have no longitude to be projected with, so they borrow the place the middle of the plot inverts back to — which is the whole reason `projection_center` exists. The aggregate below it is the second rule this fixture carries: an aggregate's rows are not the rows that went in, so a selection remembering rows by identity writes the identity again beneath it, and a circle without one could not be picked at all.
